name: Philadelphia-positive (BCR::ABL1+) adult ALL: TKI plus chemotherapy or steroids
histology: B-lineage acute lymphoblastic leukemia, BCR::ABL1 (Philadelphia chromosome) positive

biomarkers.note: BIOMARKER GATE: this protocol applies only to BCR::ABL1 (Philadelphia chromosome)-positive ALL. Harrison 22nd ed. line 120049 states Ph+ ALL maintenance should include a tyrosine kinase inhibitor; Table 111-4 (lines 120112 to 120114) lists intensive chemotherapy plus a TKI (with or without stem cell transplant), or chemotherapy plus dasatinib, as the Ph+ strategy. DeVita 12th ed. describes frontline TKI-plus-chemotherapy and TKI-plus-steroid approaches for Ph+ ALL.

drugs.name: Dasatinib
drugs.notes: Dasatinib 140 mg daily is grounded: DeVita 12th ed. line 276516 reports the EWALL Ph+ ALL regimen of dasatinib 140 mg daily with vincristine, dexamethasone, and intrathecal chemotherapy. days:[1] denotes continuous daily dosing (given every day, not day 1 only). Dasatinib crosses the blood-brain barrier (Harrison line 120148), an advantage for CNS control. A second-generation TKI - confirm cardiopulmonary/pleural-effusion monitoring and QTc per label.

drugs.name: Imatinib
drugs.notes: Alternative first-generation TKI (either/or, not additive with dasatinib/ponatinib). DeVita line 277220 names imatinib combined with hyper-CVAD for Ph+ ALL and line 276510 notes imatinib or dasatinib produce high hematologic response rates in induction, but no imatinib mg/day for ALL is printed in the ALL extract - dose, unit, and basis are VERIFY (the CML imatinib doses in Harrison Chapter 110 are CML-context and are not carried over). Imatinib does not cross the blood-brain barrier as well as dasatinib (Harrison line 120148).

drugs.name: Ponatinib
drugs.notes: Alternative third-generation TKI (either/or), active against the T315I mutation. DeVita line 276490 reports ponatinib combined with the hyper-CVAD regimen for Ph+ ALL, but no ponatinib mg/day for ALL is printed in the ALL extract - dose, unit, and basis are VERIFY (the CML ponatinib 45 mg/day in Harrison Chapter 110 is CML-context and is not carried over). Ponatinib carries arterial-thrombosis and hepatotoxicity risk - confirm cardiovascular monitoring per label.

drugs.name: vinCRIStine
drugs.notes: Chemotherapy-backbone component in the TKI-plus-chemotherapy approach (DeVita line 276516, EWALL: dasatinib plus vincristine, dexamethasone, intrathecal chemotherapy). Per-dose cap 2 mg applied as a StewardMD safety rule (ISMP tall-man vinCRIStine, IV-only, fatal if intrathecal). mg/m2 dose and days not printed - VERIFY. In lower-intensity/steroid-only TKI induction, vincristine may be omitted.

drugs.name: Dexamethasone
drugs.notes: Glucocorticoid backbone; TKI-plus-steroid induction (dasatinib or imatinib plus glucocorticoids) is an established lower-intensity approach for older/infirm Ph+ ALL patients (DeVita lines 276505 to 276512). mg dose and schedule not printed - VERIFY.

drugs.name: Intrathecal CNS prophylaxis (methotrexate +/- cytarabine)
drugs.notes: MANDATORY CNS prophylaxis (DeVita line 276516 includes intrathecal chemotherapy; Harrison lines 120134 to 120138 describe intrathecal methotrexate alone or with cytarabine). Especially important with TKIs that cross the blood-brain barrier poorly (imatinib, nilotinib) versus dasatinib/ponatinib (Harrison line 120148). Intrathecal agents are cytarabine and methotrexate ONLY; vinCRIStine must NEVER be given intrathecally. Fixed doses not printed - VERIFY.

supportiveCare: tumor lysis syndrome prophylaxis (hydration, allopurinol or rasburicase, electrolyte monitoring) - Harrison line 120030 notes ALL pre-phase therapy allows safe tumor reduction to avoid tumor lysis syndrome
TKI-specific monitoring: pleural effusion / cytopenias / QTc for dasatinib; arterial thrombosis / hepatotoxicity for ponatinib (per label)
BCR::ABL1 transcript (MRD) monitoring to guide therapy and transplant decisions (Harrison lines 120052 to 120060)
antiemetic and growth-factor support per NCCN tiers when combined with intensive chemotherapy (pending per-disease template)

monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle and during aplasia
cardiac / QTc and pleural-effusion assessment for dasatinib; cardiovascular assessment for ponatinib

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 276490 (ponatinib + hyper-CVAD), 276505 to 276512 (imatinib/dasatinib + steroids induction), 276516 (EWALL dasatinib 140 mg daily + vincristine/dexamethasone/intrathecal), 277220 (imatinib + hyper-CVAD)
lines 120049 (TKI in Ph+ maintenance), 120112 to 120114 (Table 111-4 Ph+ strategy: chemotherapy + TKI +/- SCT), 120148 (dasatinib/ponatinib cross the blood-brain barrier; imatinib/nilotinib less so)

provenanceNote: Textbook-grounded StewardMD draft for Philadelphia-positive (BCR::ABL1+) adult ALL. The BCR::ABL1-positive biomarker gate and the TKI-plus-chemotherapy / TKI-plus-steroid strategy are grounded in Harrison 22nd ed. Chapter 111 (Table 111-4, lines 120049/120112) and DeVita 12th ed. Only dasatinib 140 mg daily carries a printed dose in the adult ALL extracts (DeVita line 276516, EWALL); imatinib and ponatinib ALL doses are NOT printed and are left VERIFY rather than borrowed from the CML dosing, and the chemotherapy-backbone doses and cycle structure are VERIFY. The vincristine 2 mg per-dose cap is applied as a StewardMD safety rule. NCCN per-disease template, StewardMD clinical (R1) review, and any hospital-implementation overlay approval are pending. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
